summary: fix(quick): suppress false-positive critical disk alert when absolute free space exceeds safe threshold on multi-TB filesystems

delivery.outcome: In fixos/diagnostics/quick_snapshot.py (_alerts), downgrade critical disk alerts to warning when disk['free_bytes'] >= 50 * 1024**3 (50 GiB) and include human-readable free GB in the alert message. Verified by unit tests in tests/unit/test_quick_snapshot.py covering small and multi-TB filesystems.
nonGoals: Do not modify full fixos analysis or service scanner disk logic
Do not modify percentage threshold configuration profiles

architecture.decision: In _alerts, check disk free_bytes against SAFE_DISK_FREE_BYTES (50 GiB) before emitting critical disk alert. When free space exceeds safe threshold, emit warning severity with formatted free GB.
